hero.heading: Practical knowledge for business protection.
hero.subheading: In-depth guides, frameworks, and expert insights to help you understand compliance, risk, and governance – and act on them with confidence.

featured.title: The SME Compliance Playbook: From Reactive to Proactive
featured.description: Most small businesses treat compliance as a fire to put out. This guide shows you how to build a system that prevents fires from starting – covering regulatory monitoring, evidence collection, and board-level reporting.

guides.title: Understanding UK Regulatory Obligations for SMEs
guides.description: A plain-English breakdown of the key regulations affecting UK small businesses – from Companies House filings to sector-specific rules – and how to stay on top of them.

guides.title: How to Build a Risk Register That Actually Gets Used
guides.description: Most risk registers sit in a drawer. This guide walks you through creating a living risk register that informs decisions, satisfies auditors, and protects your business.

guides.title: GDPR Compliance for Growing Businesses: A Practical Guide
guides.description: Cut through the legal jargon. This guide covers the six lawful bases for processing, your obligations as a data controller, and how to respond to a subject access request.

guides.title: Corporate Governance Essentials for SME Directors
guides.description: What does good governance actually look like for a business with 10–200 employees? This guide covers board responsibilities, decision-making frameworks, and audit readiness.

guides.title: Employment Law Fundamentals: What Every UK Employer Must Know
guides.description: From contracts and working time to disciplinary procedures and redundancy – a practical overview of your obligations as an employer and how to document them properly.

guides.title: How to Prepare for a Regulatory Inspection
guides.description: Regulators give little notice. This guide helps you build an evidence library, organise your documentation, and brief your team so you are always inspection-ready.

guides.title: Cyber Risk for Non-Technical Business Owners
guides.description: You do not need to be a technologist to manage cyber risk. This guide explains the key threats, the controls that matter most, and how to communicate risk to your board.

guides.title: Writing Policies That People Actually Follow
guides.description: A policy no one reads is a liability, not a protection. Learn how to write clear, proportionate policies, get sign-off, and build a culture of compliance from the top down.

guides.title: Data Retention: How Long Should You Keep Business Records?
guides.description: Keeping data too long is a GDPR risk. Deleting it too soon could breach other laws. This guide maps out retention periods for common business record types.

cta.heading: See how Jojan One puts this into practice.
cta.subheading: The platform monitors your obligations, generates the documents, and builds the evidence – so you spend less time on compliance and more time on your business.
